parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `HLSPlayerTests.stallYieldsEvent` (line 376) and `HLSPlayerTests.recoveryYieldsEvent` (line 402) — reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/HLSPlayerTests.swift` and carry `is_test: true`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.778 suggests structural overlap that could in principle motivate a shared generic helper, test methods that verify distinct player lifecycle events (stall vs. recovery) are intentionally named and scoped separately to preserve test-failure legibility and independent failure attribution. Collapsing them into a generic parameterized function would obscure which scenario failed and is contrary to standard XCTest idiom.
